description: packages/formatting/src/blocknoteUtils.ts exports a sanitizeHref helper that returns a safe href string or null, allowing http, https and mailto schemes only.

sanitizeHref normalizes its input before evaluating the scheme: leading and trailing whitespace, embedded tab/newline/NUL control characters, and case are neutralized so JaVaScRiPt: and java\tscript: are rejected.
sanitizeHref rejects protocol-relative URLs (//host) rather than treating them as scheme-less.
sanitizeHref preserves scheme-less relative paths (/terms, terms.html) and fragments (#section).

The BlockNote-to-HTML link emission at blocknoteUtils.ts:526 routes its href through sanitizeHref and escapeHtml, and omits the anchor entirely when sanitizeHref returns null, emitting the link text alone.
The ProseMirror-to-HTML link mark at blocknoteUtils.ts:840 routes its href through sanitizeHref, omitting the anchor when rejected.
The BlockNote-to-Markdown link emission at blocknoteUtils.ts:262 routes its href through sanitizeHref, emitting bare text when rejected.
The ProseMirror-to-Markdown link mark at blocknoteUtils.ts:1014 routes its href through sanitizeHref, emitting bare text when rejected.
The no-op escape at blocknoteUtils.ts:754 (codeBlock text) is replaced with escapeHtml, so code block content is HTML-escaped in convertBlockNoteToHTML output.
prdRefs: Problem > The security defect this uncovers

description: The no-op escape at blocknoteUtils.ts:786 (unknown-block string content) is replaced with escapeHtml.
The language prop interpolated into class="language-${language}" at blocknoteUtils.ts:755 is escaped, matching the already-correct ProseMirror path at :914.
The image src emission at blocknoteUtils.ts:774 routes its URL through sanitizeHref, extended to allow the data: scheme for images only, and omits the img element when rejected.
Colour values interpolated into style attributes (blocknoteUtils.ts:303, 308, 337, 500, 572-580, 638-653) are escaped or validated before emission.
The textAlignment prop interpolated into style at blocknoteUtils.ts:638-653 is constrained to a known set of alignment values rather than interpolated raw.
The divergent inline escapers at blocknoteUtils.ts:531, 550, 563 are replaced by calls to the shared escapeHtml helper, leaving one escaping implementation in the file.
A migration adds quotes.terms_and_conditions_block as a nullable jsonb column, guarded by a hasColumn check, with one subcommand per alterTable call and a working down migration.
IQuote and QuoteViewModel in packages/types/src/interfaces/quote.interfaces.ts carry terms_and_conditions_block alongside terms_and_conditions.
packages/billing/src/schemas/quoteSchemas.ts accepts terms_and_conditions_block on create and update.
A shared helper flattens BlockNote block content to plain text for the terms_and_conditions projection column, used by every write path so the two columns cannot drift.
createQuote writes both columns: the block column as given, the text column as the flattened projection of it.
updateQuote writes both columns together, and clearing the rich value clears both.
createQuoteFromTemplate (quoteActions.ts:1117) copies terms_and_conditions_block alongside terms_and_conditions, preserving its input-over-template-over-null precedence for both.
duplicateQuote (quoteActions.ts:1179) copies both columns.
saveQuoteAsTemplate (quoteActions.ts:1251) copies both columns.
Quote.createRevision (packages/billing/src/models/quote.ts:407) copies both columns.
The workflow duplicate path (shared/workflow/runtime/actions/businessOperations/crm.ts:1611) copies both columns.
A plain-string write through the REST API (server/src/lib/api/schemas/quoteSchemas.ts) sets the text column and clears the block column, so the written value is the displayed value.
A plain-string write through the workflow business operations sets the text column and clears the block column.
TemplateNodeType and the TemplateNode union in packages/types/src/lib/invoice-template-ast.ts gain a richText node carrying a content value expression.
The zod nodeSchema in packages/billing/src/lib/invoice-template-ast/schema.ts gains the matching strict richText variant, and NodeInput mirrors it.
react-renderer.tsx renders a richText node by resolving its content binding and emitting convertBlockContentToHTML output through dangerouslySetInnerHTML.
A richText node whose resolved content is a plain string renders it as escaped text with whiteSpace: 'pre-line', matching the text node's treatment rather than passing it to the converter.

A richText node whose resolved content is null, undefined or empty falls back to the legacy text node's empty pre-line paragraph (never the converter's '[No content]' placeholder), so migrated stock layouts reproduce the pre-change PDF output byte-for-byte.
The AST text node is left unchanged, so every existing layout renders as before.
i18nLabels.ts resolveNode handles the richText node type so its content expression participates in i18n resolution like the text node's.
mapLoadedQuoteToViewModel (packages/billing/src/lib/adapters/quoteAdapters.ts:583) exposes terms_and_conditions_block on the view model.
The termsAndConditions binding resolves to the block column when it is populated and the text column otherwise.

standardTemplates.ts (packages/billing/src/lib/quote-template-ast/) declares terms-copy as a richText node in all four stock layouts, so the in-code fallback used by templateSelection.ts matches the seeded rows.
A migration rewrites the terms-copy node to type richText in standard_quote_document_templates rows for the four standard quote template codes.

The same migration rewrites terms-copy in tenant-owned quote_document_templates rows, and only where the node still matches the stock shape (type 'text' bound to termsAndConditions), leaving customized nodes untouched.
The terms-copy migration is idempotent and has a down migration that restores the text node type.
workspaceAst.ts AST import no longer silently discards a node whose type is absent from typeMap (:1892 'if (!designerType) return'); it raises instead.
DesignerComponentType (designerStore.ts) gains a richText component type and typeMap maps the AST richText node to it.
componentSchema.ts defines the richText component's schema and the palette catalog (componentCatalog.ts) exposes it.
DesignCanvas.tsx renders a richText node in the canvas preview.
workspaceAst.ts converts richText in both directions, round-tripping the content expression through metadata the way the text node does at :1909.
A shared quote-terms display component converts block content to HTML once and renders it, so no display surface carries its own conversion.
QuoteForm.tsx replaces the Terms & Conditions TextArea (:1494) with the standard BlockNote editor, keeping the field inside the Client-facing text card.
QuoteFormState carries the terms value as block content, and handleChange's generic string setter no longer coerces it.
The editor seeds from terms_and_conditions_block, falling back to a single paragraph built from terms_and_conditions when the block column is null.
The Terms & Conditions editor renders for business templates on the same terms as quotes, and the template-selection prefill path (QuoteForm.tsx:393-402) carries block content.
The Terms & Conditions editor is read-only when the form is read-only, matching the TextArea's disabled behaviour.
QuoteDetail.tsx (:1260) renders terms through the shared display component instead of a whitespace-pre-wrap paragraph, keeping its em-dash placeholder when empty.
The client portal's QuoteDetailPage.tsx (:653) renders terms through the same shared display component, keeping its behaviour of hiding the section when empty.
Interactive elements added to QuoteForm carry unique id attributes per the repo's component ID guidelines, and the editor renders correctly in both light and dark themes.
